The '''Zadaria system''' was located in the [[Gateworlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Febrini system/Legends|Febrini]] and [[Phelope system/Legends|Phelope systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Zadaria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Zadarian brandy]].<ref name="Journal8">{{JournalCite|8|A Certain Point of View (short story)}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Zadarian brandy]]|system=Zadaria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Zadaria system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
